annotations.title: Write or change an UpFork article

description: Saves the user's article: what's given changes, the rest stays (body replaces the whole text; tags the whole list). Answers with what must be put right (problems): fix every one. Every article carries at least one :::lesson block, something learned building the product that wasn't known before (see article_guide). Name the model writing in model, as you name yourself ("Claude Opus 5.5"): the article tells its readers it was written with it. A published article's changes reach readers only with publish_article. Not while it waits for review.

article.description: The article's id, from my_articles or create_article.

body.description: The whole text, Markdown with the product's blocks (see article_guide), up to 100 kB.

cover.description: A picture's id from add_article_image to make it the cover, or "none" for no cover (the product's picture shows).

model.description: The AI model writing, as it names itself, e.g. "Claude Opus 5.5". Shown on the article.

summary.description: A sentence or two, up to 200 characters: search engines show it under the title.

tags.description: Up to 5 of the site's own tags (the whole list).

type.description: tutorials, behind-the-build, performance, design or tips-and-fixes.

name: update_article

outputSchema.description: One of the user's articles as they edit it: what's saved, what's wrong with it, and what to do next.

aiModels.description: The AI models named on it as having written it.

body.description: Its text, in Markdown with the product's blocks.

changes.description: Saved changes readers don't see yet.

coverId.description: Its cover picture's id, if it has one.

editorUrl.description: Where the user reads and edits it on upfork.dev, as it will look.

items.description: A ::file block, as the article keeps it.

changed.description: The file has changed since these lines were kept (save again to take the new lines).

gone.description: The file isn't in the product any more.

id.description: Give it as article to the other tools.

images.description: Its pictures, its cover among them.

id.description: Give it to update_article as cover to make it the cover.

markdown.description: Put this line in the text where the picture goes, with words that describe it.

indexed.description: Whether search engines will list it (300 words or more).

live.description: Whether readers can read a version of it.

locked.description: Its product's code is paid: 60 lines a block, 200 an article.

off.description: The user took it off the site: only they see it until hide_article puts it back.

problems.description: What must be put right before it can go out. Fix every one.

product.description: The product it's about, by slug.

reviewNote.description: What UpFork's reviewer asked to change.

slug.description: Its name in its address (it follows the title until it's first published).

suggestedTags.description: Tags of the site's that fit it (tags are the site's own only).

words.description: How many words it has (code left out).

title: Write or change an UpFork article
